sentences.zh: 《编程大乱斗》，第 37 期，时髦的编程语言。

sentences.en: Take it away, Jason.
sentences.zh: 开始吧，Jason。

sentences.en: Hey, everybody.
sentences.zh: 嘿，大家好。

sentences.en: So, yeah, we got an interesting question from...
sentences.zh: 嗯，没错，我们收到一个有趣的问题，来自……

sentences.en: Many interesting questions.
sentences.zh: 很多有趣的问题。

sentences.en: Yeah, we got several interesting...
sentences.zh: 是啊，我们收到了好几个有趣的……

sentences.en: Yeah, definitely, several interesting questions.
sentences.zh: 没错，确实，好几个有趣的问题。

sentences.en: I try to answer them on Google Plus, Facebook, Twitter, wherever they come, email.
sentences.zh: 我试着在 Google Plus、Facebook、Twitter 或者其他任何他们联系我的地方，还有邮件里回答这些问题。

sentences.en: But this one was particularly interesting.
sentences.zh: 但这个问题特别有意思。

sentences.en: So, yeah, we wanted to discuss it on the show.
sentences.zh: 所以，没错，我们想在节目里讨论一下。

sentences.en: So, Will wrote in and said,
sentences.zh: Will 写信来说，

sentences.en: Basically, what do you guys think about moving to Silicon Valley?
sentences.zh: 基本上，你们觉得搬到硅谷怎么样？

sentences.en: You know, I live on the East CoaSt.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我住在东海岸。

sentences.en: He lives in a small town in Georgia.
sentences.zh: 他住在佐治亚州的一个小镇上。

sentences.en: I'm assuming he's doing tech, developing mobile applications.
sentences.zh: 我猜他是在做技术，开发移动应用。

sentences.en: And he just wants to know, should I, you know, make the trip over to Silicon Valley?
sentences.zh: 他只是想知道，我该不该，你知道，去硅谷闯一闯？

sentences.en: So, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 这个嘛，我不知道。

sentences.en: What do you think?
sentences.zh: 你怎么看？

sentences.en: I'll let you have the first shot of this.
sentences.zh: 我让你先说。

sentences.en: There are many factors which should influence one's decision to relocate.
sentences.zh: 影响一个人搬迁决定的因素有很多。

sentences.en: Oh, God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: First, so, no, no, no.
sentences.zh: 首先，所以，不，不，不。

sentences.en: But seriously, like, if you've never visited and you haven't, like, if you're just thinking, like, should I interview?
sentences.zh: 但说真的，如果你从来没去过，而且你还没，比如，你只是在想，我该不该去面试？

sentences.en: The answer is, yes, you should probably interview.
sentences.zh: 答案是，是的，你可能应该去面试。

sentences.en: Well, that makes sense.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这很有道理。

sentences.en: More generally, you should interview.
sentences.zh: 更普遍地说，你应该去面试。

sentences.en: Part of that is you'll probably get a chance to come out here because we are in the Silicon Valley.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是，你很可能会有机会来这里，因为我们就在硅谷。

sentences.en: So, that's why I say here.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是我为什么说“这里”。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, you'll get a chance to come out and visit, see what it's like.
sentences.zh: 所以，你会有机会过来看看，了解一下这里是什么样。

sentences.en: But, I mean, everybody will tell you their property is really expensive.
sentences.zh: 但是，我是说，每个人都会告诉你这里的房产真的很贵。

sentences.en: It's expensive to buy a place to live in or even just to rent a place, at least in the really kind of main part of Silicon Valley.
sentences.zh: 买房住或者仅仅是租房都很贵，至少在硅谷的核心地带是这样。

sentences.en: But there is a reason why everybody wants to live here.
sentences.zh: 但每个人都想住在这里是有原因的。

sentences.en: That is that there's a lot of good places to work and, you know, the area is beautiful, the weather is great, and people love paying taxes.
sentences.zh: 那就是这里有很多好的工作机会，而且，你知道，这个地区很美，天气很好，人们也乐于纳税。

sentences.en: People love paying taxes.
sentences.zh: 人们乐于纳税。

sentences.en: I think you make a really good point.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你说的很有道理。

sentences.en: If you interview, provided you make it past the phone screen, you basically get a free trip to Silicon Valley.
sentences.zh: 如果你去面试，只要通过了电话筛选，你基本上就获得了一次去硅谷的免费旅行。

sentences.en: That's for most big companies.
sentences.zh: 大多数大公司都是这样。

sentences.en: Every company is a little different, but most big companies are that way.
sentences.zh: 每家公司都有点不同，但大多数大公司都是这样。

sentences.en: Even startups, actually.
sentences.zh: 其实连初创公司也是。

sentences.en: Like, when I was looking around when I was still on the East Coast,
sentences.zh: 比如，当我还在东海岸找工作的时候，

sentences.en: startups would also pay for you to come.
sentences.zh: 初创公司也会付钱让你过去。

sentences.en: Oh, okay.
sentences.zh: 哦，好吧。

sentences.en: Yeah, at the time I was interviewing at Tesla,
sentences.zh: 是啊，当时我在特斯拉面试，

sentences.en: and at the time they were, like, a really small company, and they totally flew me over there or offered to fly me over there, ended up picking a different company.
sentences.zh: 那时候他们还是一家非常小的公司，他们完全愿意飞我过去，或者说提议飞我过去，最后我选了另一家公司。

sentences.en: But, yeah, so, you know, you can interview, get a free trip.
sentences.zh: 但，没错，所以，你知道，你可以去面试，顺便来一次免费旅行。

sentences.en: Make sure you, if possible, interview on, you know, like a Monday or a Friday so you can come the weekend or at least, you know, take some days off or something.
sentences.zh: 如果可能的话，确保在周一或周五面试，这样你就可以在周末过来，或者至少，你知道，请几天假之类的。

sentences.en: And be up front with the recruiter, right, because their job is to be very nice to you.
sentences.zh: 而且要对招聘人员坦诚，对吧，因为他们的工作就是对你非常友好。

sentences.en: And I was, I'm always, I give this advice, but I know I was always very timid in asking for things or accommodation, basically.
sentences.zh: 我一直，我总是给出这个建议，但我知道我在要求事情或住宿时总是很胆怯。

sentences.en: But, you know, if you have a significant other, a spouse or something, don't take advantage of it, in my opinion.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，如果你有另一半、配偶什么的，依我看，不要占这个便宜。

sentences.en: But, like, you know, if they're debating whether or not they would also like to move, you should say, hey, like, as a couple, we're determining this.
sentences.zh: 但是，比如，如果他们正在讨论是否也想搬过来，你应该说，嘿，作为一对伴侣，我们正在考虑这件事。

sentences.en: Like, is it possible for my wife to join me on this trip or whatever?
sentences.zh: 比如，我妻子能和我一起参加这次旅行吗，之类的？

sentences.en: Yeah, that's a really good point.
sentences.zh: 没错，这确实是个好点子。

sentences.en: I mean, I didn't do that, and I kind of regretted it.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我当时没这么做，还有点后悔。

sentences.en: I mean, it worked out fine, but it was a little nerve-wracking for my wife to, like, literally our first day in California was the day we moved.
sentences.zh: 我是说，结果还行，但我妻子当时有点紧张，因为我们在加州的第一天实际上就是我们搬家的那天。

sentences.en: And it's like there's really no going back.
sentences.zh: 而且感觉真的没有回头路了。

sentences.en: And so, yeah, if I had to do it over again, I would have asked.
sentences.zh: 所以，没错，如果能重来一次，我会提出来的。

sentences.en: You know, if you think about it, if you interview at, like, a big company, you know, $200 or $300 plane ticket, I mean,
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你想想看，如果你去一家大公司面试，你知道，两三百美元的机票，我是说，

sentences.en: they, you know, they're not going to, it's not going to set them back.
sentences.zh: 他们，你知道，他们不会，这不会让他们损失什么。

sentences.en: And it could really do you a lot of good.
sentences.zh: 而且这真的能让你受益匪浅。

sentences.en: And having another person isn't really that big a deal because, like, you know, they don't have to pay for another hotel room or really anything.
sentences.zh: 而且多带一个人其实也没什么大不了的，因为，你知道，他们不需要多付一间酒店房费，或者真的什么都不用多付。

sentences.en: So I did ask it from one recruiter, not for the Bay Area, but for another area, and I did ask.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实向一位招聘人员提过，不是针对湾区，而是针对另一个地区，我确实问了。

sentences.en: And they said that I could.
sentences.zh: 他们说我可以。

sentences.en: I didn't end up taking them up on it because I ended up taking another offer.
sentences.zh: 我最终没有接受他们的提议，因为我接受了另一份工作。

sentences.en: But they were very, you know, sure, of course, you know, like, that's no problem.
sentences.zh: 但他们非常，你知道，当然可以，你知道，这没问题。

sentences.en: And I had actually already flown there and interviewed, and I was asking to fly me and my wife together out again to do kind of like an exploration trip.
sentences.zh: 而且我当时其实已经飞过去面试过了，我是在要求他们再次飞我和我妻子过去，进行一次考察之旅。

sentences.en: And they were okay with that as well.
sentences.zh: 他们对此也没意见。

sentences.en: Yeah, right.
sentences.zh: 是啊，没错。

sentences.en: So that totally makes sense.
sentences.zh: 所以这完全说得通。

sentences.en: So getting back to the question.
sentences.zh: 回到问题上来。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，没错。

sentences.en: Yeah, no, no.
sentences.zh: 是啊，不，不。

sentences.en: I mean, so you're right that you should definitely interview and all that.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你说得对，你绝对应该去面试之类的。

sentences.en: So we didn't waste time or anything.
sentences.zh: 所以我们没浪费时间什么的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: But should you move?
sentences.zh: 但你应该搬家吗？

sentences.en: Should you move to Silicon Valley?
sentences.zh: 你应该搬到硅谷吗？

sentences.en: So here's my take on it.
sentences.zh: 这是我的看法。

sentences.en: So this is a little bit of a different question, but it'll come back to the main point.
sentences.zh: 这是一个稍微不同的问题，但会回到重点。

sentences.en: Somebody asked me, how come we can't just recreate Silicon Valley, you know, in Florida or somewhere else, right?
sentences.zh: 有人问我，为什么我们不能在佛罗里达或其他地方重建一个硅谷，对吧？

sentences.en: And there's been many attempts.
sentences.zh: 而且已经有很多尝试了。

sentences.en: Like, there's a place in India that's supposed to be like a technology triangle that's trying to be like an incubator.
sentences.zh: 比如，印度有个地方号称是技术三角区，试图成为一个孵化器。

sentences.en: You know, there's a lot of places all over the world that are like kind of tech incubators.
sentences.zh: 你知道，世界各地有很多地方都像是科技孵化器。

sentences.en: Um, and a lot of them like get traction and of course they're successful to some degree, but like none of them are close to the success of Silicon Valley, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，很多地方确实获得了关注，当然在某种程度上也是成功的，但没有一个能接近硅谷的成功，对吧？

sentences.en: And what I think about this is that you have sort of this pool of talent and a lot of the information you need to be a successful tech company is sort of latent.
sentences.zh: 关于这一点，我的想法是，你拥有某种人才库，而且成为一家成功的科技公司所需的大部分信息都是潜在的。

sentences.en: You know, it's, it's, it's lessons learned.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是，这是，这是经验教训。

sentences.en: It's not something you can really find in school, especially now because, you know, there's so much disconnect.
sentences.zh: 这不是你在学校里真正能学到的东西，尤其是现在，因为，你知道，脱节太严重了。

sentences.en: Like people in Silicon Valley aren't going back to university and teaching or anything like that.
sentences.zh: 比如硅谷的人不会回到大学去教书之类的。

sentences.en: So there's just so many lessons to be learned and so much, um, sort of what's the word for it where it's like, uh, you just kind of have to, you know, be grandfathered into it.
sentences.zh: 所以有太多的经验需要学习，还有太多的，嗯，怎么说呢，就是你必须，你知道，被这种环境熏陶。

sentences.en: There's not really a way to learn other than, yeah.
sentences.zh: 除了这样，真的没有别的学习方法。

sentences.en: It's like this, this language that's evolved over time that basically, you know, to be a successful company, you need a couple of say, you know, Silicon Valley veterans.
sentences.zh: 这就像这种随着时间演变的语言，基本上，你知道，要成为一家成功的公司，你需要几个，比如，硅谷老手。

sentences.en: And so if there was some kind of migration out of the Valley, then we could get these incubators and other places.
sentences.zh: 所以如果硅谷出现某种人才外流，那么我们就能在其他地方建立这些孵化器。

sentences.en: But at the moment, you know, the best place and one of the only places to get sort of veterans who have been doing, you know, big data or, or, you know, practical machine
sentences.zh: 但目前，你知道，获得那些一直在做，你知道，大数据，或者，或者，你知道，实用机器学习

sentences.en: learning or whatever, um, is, is here and those people aren't moving.
sentences.zh: 之类的老手，最好的地方，也是唯一的地方，就是这里，而且这些人不会搬走。

sentences.en: So, um, so there are other, but there are other places.
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，所以还有其他，但还有其他地方。

sentences.en: Like I read stuff a lot, um, about New York, right?
sentences.zh: 比如我经常读到关于纽约的东西，对吧？

sentences.en: And it's not to the same degree of startups, but like New York city has a lot of tech jobs and, and tech industry.
sentences.zh: 虽然初创公司的程度没那么高，但纽约市确实有很多科技工作和科技产业。

sentences.en: And it somewhat, I think it's partly just the, you need a certain density of people and then a certain percentage of those people to be, you know, technologically minded, advanced
sentences.zh: 而且在某种程度上，我认为这部分是因为，你需要一定的人口密度，然后其中一定比例的人是，你知道，有技术头脑的、先进的

sentences.en: computer science, people like that kind of stuff.
sentences.zh: 计算机科学人才，诸如此类的人。

sentences.en: And the areas, like if you take, uh, you know, Jason and I are both from Florida.
sentences.zh: 而这些地区，比如如果你看看，呃，你知道，Jason 和我都是来自佛罗里达。

sentences.en: If you take the areas in Florida where we were, even if there may be a lot of people, the density is relatively low.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看我们所在的佛罗里达地区，即使那里可能有很多人口，但密度相对较低。

sentences.en: And, uh, the number of people who are from a technology background is also very low.
sentences.zh: 而且，有技术背景的人数也非常少。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And there's a chicken and an egg problem because, um, let's say you're a brand new company, uh, like you're some startup, you just have an idea, you know, you're Uber and you want
sentences.zh: 这存在一个先有鸡还是先有蛋的问题，因为，嗯，假设你是一家全新的公司，呃，比如你是一家初创公司，你只有一个想法，你知道，你是 Uber，你想

sentences.en: to be, you know, a phone app where people can request bars that they show up, bartenders and they show up, um,
sentences.zh: 成为一个手机应用，人们可以请求酒吧，然后他们就会出现，调酒师就会出现，嗯，

sentences.en: you know, you're going to have like a little bit of funding to get
sentences.zh: 你知道，你会有一点资金来开始

sentences.en: started and you need to get some very talented people or at least one very talented person to build, you know, version one of the system.
sentences.zh: 起步，你需要找到一些非常有才华的人，或者至少一个非常有才华的人来构建，你知道，系统的第一个版本。

sentences.en: That means you're going to have to find someone who's willing to quit their job and take a huge risk to join your company.
sentences.zh: 这意味着你必须找到一个愿意辞职并冒巨大风险加入你公司的人。

sentences.en: And that means you have to go through a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 这意味着你必须接触很多人。

sentences.en: Like it might be a one in 10,000, uh, chance that you find someone who's in that position.
sentences.zh: 比如，你找到处于那种位置的人的几率可能是万分之一。

sentences.en: And so if you go to say, you know, Florida, where there might only be 9,000 people who have that kind of skillset, now you're really in trouble.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你去，比如，你知道，佛罗里达，那里可能只有 9000 人具备那种技能，那你真的有麻烦了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so because of that, you know, you don't have this sort of snowball effect.
sentences.zh: 正因为如此，你知道，你没有这种滚雪球效应。

sentences.en: And so Silicon Valley is like one of the few places where you can, um, where you can go and find some very senior people to work on something, you know, that's just an idea.
sentences.zh: 所以硅谷是少数几个你可以，嗯，你可以去找到一些非常资深的人来从事某项工作的地方，你知道，那仅仅是一个想法。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: So, so I would say, should I move?
sentences.zh: 所以，所以我会说，我该搬吗？

sentences.en: It's obviously subject to a lot of personal decisions and it is expensive to live here, but I mean, there are two things that are good is one is Jason kind of talked about like
sentences.zh: 这显然取决于很多个人决定，而且住在这里确实很贵，但我是说，有两点是好的，一是 Jason 提到的，比如

sentences.en: those talented people.
sentences.zh: 那些有才华的人。

sentences.en: It's also good for you as an employee, because there's a lot of people to learn from, uh, and
sentences.zh: 这对你作为员工也很好，因为有很多可以学习的对象，呃，而且

sentences.en: a lot of really smart people typically, um, you know, there are not smart people too, I guess, but there are a lot of smart people.
sentences.zh: 通常有很多非常聪明的人，嗯，你知道，也有不聪明的人，我想，但确实有很多聪明人。

sentences.en: And if you can find them, you can learn a lot, not even at your own company, but just like everywhere.
sentences.zh: 如果你能找到他们，你就能学到很多，甚至不需要在自己的公司，到处都是。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's all around you.
sentences.zh: 它就在你身边。

sentences.en: Yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 是啊，绝对的。

sentences.en: The other thing is like, for me, it's much better to move on my terMs.
sentences.zh: 另一件事是，对我来说，按我的条件搬家要好得多。

sentences.en: Like I decided, like I wanted to move and moved out here.
sentences.zh: 比如我决定了，我想搬家，然后就搬到这里来了。

sentences.en: Um, and then now if something happened and I was forced into needing to get a different job or, you know, there was a downturn in my company, right.
sentences.zh: 嗯，然后现在如果发生了什么事，我被迫需要找另一份工作，或者，你知道，我的公司出现了衰退，对吧。

sentences.en: Then I would be forced to, uh, relocate.
sentences.zh: 那么我就会被迫，呃，搬迁。

sentences.en: And if I'm here, the chance of me having to relocate away is, uh, low compared to where I was before.
sentences.zh: 如果我在这里，我被迫搬离这里的几率，呃，比起我以前住的地方要低。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's true.
sentences.zh: 是啊，那倒是真的。

sentences.en: Now there's still the problem of like, what happens, like what happened in 2000s with the tech burst tech bubble burSt.
sentences.zh: 现在仍然存在一个问题，比如，会发生什么，就像 2000 年代科技泡沫破裂时发生的那样。

sentences.en: Um, but I'm already in the tech industry.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但我已经在科技行业了。

sentences.en: So like in general, it's going to be a bad time for me, regardless of where I am.
sentences.zh: 所以，总的来说，无论我在哪里，这对我来说都是一段糟糕的时期。

sentences.en: Yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 是啊，绝对的。

sentences.en: Definitely.
sentences.zh: 绝对的。
